:::{#def-propositional-logic}
#### Propositional logic

**Propositional logic**
[@wikipedia_propositional_calculus]
is the study of
[logical entailment](#def-logical-entailment)
among [propositions](#def-proposition)
built from basic propositions $P, Q, R, \ldots$
using only the [logical connectives](#def-logical-connective).
Whether such propositions entail one another
depends only on the truth values of the basic propositions, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
not on what the basic propositions say.

:::
